title: Let belonging become generous
summary: All belong to the One who is the wealth of all. Let shared dependence make the heart less possessive and more ready to pray for everyone.
takeaway: Let shared dependence make belonging generous.
lifeApplication: When you feel the urge to guard your place, pause and pray as one beggar among many before the same generous Lord.

source.shortMeaning: All belong to the One who is the wealth of all, and everyone stands before that Source in prayer.
source.lifeApplication: When worth feels scarce, let the line widen belonging instead of turning it into private property.

evidence.coreClaim: Belonging is received from the One who belongs to all and sustains all.
evidence.turn: Shared dependence breaks the possessive reflex.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you feel the urge to guard your place, pause and pray as one beggar among many before the same generous Lord.
